answer: A per-identity slashable stake is the key defense. Every agent must lock collateral for the epoch, so a Sybil farm's cost scales with identity count while per-bot reward hits a nadir. One verdict against the cluster burns all its bonds, and fresh identities face a re-lock delay. Honest agents risk one bond; a thousand-node farm risks a thousand and loses them together, so the attack cannot pay. A cheap echo of a banned operator does not help, since slashed history stays visible to graders. Collusion deepens the spiral: each fake agent raises sunk cost linearly while payout stays flat.
